applied.problem: Absolutes a specialist would not sign: 'the acid is used up' (a flat cell still holds weak acid, as the interactive shows); voltage 'fixed' by plate material; and 'voltage tells you what the plates are made of, not how much' clashes with i2, where rested voltage tracks charge via acid strength.
'It is used up on discharge' says all the acid goes; only part of it is used, and a flat cell still holds weak acid (as the explanation and interactive show).
'the acid is used up in the making' says all the acid goes; a discharged cell keeps weak acid, so only much of it is used.
